	return Vector2D(X + A, Y + A); //[0x0]
	return Vector2D(X - A, Y - A); //[0x0]
	return Vector2D(X* V.X, Y* V.Y); //[0x0]
	return Vector2D(X / V.X, Y / V.Y); //[0x0]
	return sqrt(pow(PE_Result.X - X, 2) + pow(PE_Result.Y - Y, 2)); //[0x0]
	return sqrt(pow(PE_Result.X - a.X, 2) + pow(PE_Result.Y - a.Y, 2)); //[0x0]
	return sqrt(X* X + Y* Y); //[0x0]
	return (a.X* vOther.X + a.Y* vOther.Y); //[0x0]
